title: FootballerStats
name: footballerstats
description: A MediaWiki gadget for editing footballer infoboxes and club career statistics on Wikipedia.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js -- --fix && npm run lint:css -- --fix
scripts.check: node --check FootballerStats.tr.js && node --check FootballerStats.en.js && npm run lint && npm test
